title: Better Reply Secure Game
body_html:
Better Reply Secure Game

A game $G$ is better reply secure if for every Reny solution $(s,v)$, the profile $s$ is a Nash equilibrium.

In this condition, Nash profiles and the strategy-profile components of Reny solutions coincide.

References

  • [MFoGT, Definition 4.8.5] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Better reply security for discontinuous games.
